art.concept: A gaunt, unnaturally fast zombie: sinewy limbs with exposed tendons, torn clothes, and veins glowing acid green under grey-green skin.
A zombie with a swollen, translucent throat sac full of glowing acid and a jaw hanging open, drool dripping green.
A hulking chimpanzee-shaped zombie: knuckle-walking on huge forearms, scarred hide with tumours and exposed bone, a heavy brow and a cracked tusk.
art.silhouette: gorilla-like, hunched, arms to the ground

theme: Rotting infection: sickly green flesh (#5f7a3a), necrotic dark violet veins (#3d1f47), dried blood brown (#5a2a1c), bone yellow (#cfc79a) and glowing acid green (#9be32f). Torn, filthy clothing, exposed muscle and tendons, oozing pustules.

behaviors.title: Infection and factions
behaviors.description: Any villager, vanilla zombie or pillager hit by a Runner, a Spitter or a Brute becomes infected. After the infection time (assumed 10 seconds, with green particles around it) the infected mob is replaced where it stands by one of the three infectious zombies, chosen at random with equal chance. Infectious zombies never attack each other or infected mobs; the Runner attacks everything else it can reach (players, animals, golems and non-infected mobs).
acceptance: A villager hit by a Runner shows infection particles and, after 10 seconds, is replaced by a Runner, a Spitter or a Brute
A vanilla zombie hit by a Brute is converted the same way
A pillager hit by a Spitter is converted the same way
Over 30 conversions all three variants appear
A Runner attacks a player, a villager and a cow within range, and ignores a Spitter, a Brute and an infected villager

behaviors.title: Infectious Poison and acid spit
behaviors.description: The Spitter attacks from range: when its target is within 16 blocks it spits an acid projectile. A hit applies Infectious Poison, a new damage-over-time effect (assumed 2 damage every second for 8 seconds). Any villager, vanilla zombie or pillager that dies while under Infectious Poison is replaced by a random infectious zombie, as in the infection system. Infectious zombies are never targeted by the acid.
acceptance: A Spitter with a target 10 blocks away shoots an acid projectile
A projectile that hits a mob applies Infectious Poison and the mob takes damage over time
A villager that dies while under Infectious Poison is replaced by a random infectious zombie
The acid never hits or poisons a Runner, Spitter or Brute

behaviors.title: Brute breaks blocks and leaps
behaviors.description: The Brute breaks the blocks in its way to its target, as hard as deepslate and no harder: stone, dirt, wood and deepslate yes; obsidian and bedrock never. It can jump up to 4 blocks high to reach a target on a ledge. Its 80 health points and primate build are set in the mob itself.
acceptance: A Brute with a target behind a stone wall and a deepslate block breaks both to reach it
A Brute does not break obsidian or bedrock
A Brute reaches a target standing on a ledge 4 blocks high

behaviors.title: Brute thrown blocks and shield breaker
behaviors.description: When its target is far (assumed more than 8 blocks) the Brute picks up a nearby block and throws it; a hit applies Slowness for 5 seconds. It prefers to get close and fight in melee, and its melee attacks break shields: a blocked hit disables the shield for 5 seconds.
acceptance: A Brute with a target 12 blocks away throws a block at it
A thrown block that hits applies Slowness
A Brute with a target within 3 blocks attacks in melee instead of throwing
A player blocking with a shield has the shield disabled by a Brute's melee hit

assumptions: Zombie baseline is 20 health, speed 0.23, damage 3: Runner 30 health and speed 0.38, Spitter 24 health, Brute 80 health (as asked) and damage 9.
Infection takes 10 seconds, picks each of the three variants with equal chance and does not affect players.
Infectious Poison deals 2 damage every second for 8 seconds; the Spitter spits within 16 blocks.
The Brute throws blocks beyond 8 blocks and fights in melee closer; shields stay disabled for 5 seconds.
No natural spawning was asked for: the three variants come from spawn eggs and from infection.
